one_line: Foundational Meitei king of Kangla in Manipur’s early court traditions, linked to the serpent-dragon deity Pakhangba.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, lean athletic build with wiry strength
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, slightly arched brows and intense large anime-style eyes; default expression is calm, regal focus with a hint of wary alertness as if guarding Kangla.
appearance.hair: long straight black hair parted slightly off-center, drawn back into a high knot at the crown and secured with a narrow plain bronze band; the knot’s end falls as a short tail to mid-neck, with two slim side-locks left in front of the ears.
appearance.costume: Era-evocative early Meitei royal attire: a knee-length off-white handwoven cotton dhoti wrapped around the waist and pleated slightly to the left, bordered with a thin deep-red edge; over it a fitted sleeveless off-white cotton upper garment that covers the torso fully and ties under the arms, over which he wears a chest-crossing sash of light cream silk with a subtle repeating wave motif in pale gold referencing the Pakhangba serpent; around his waist a broad deep-red cloth belt (phanek-like wrap) with a thin dark-green line near the top; he has a light, unpatterned beige cotton shawl draped from the left shoulder across the back and under the right arm in courtly style; on his wrists are simple bronze bangles and on his upper right arm a single bronze armband shaped like a very subtle coiled serpent; feet are in dark-brown leather sandals with simple thong straps, historically plausible for early valley terrain; overall textiles appear handwoven with fine but not luxurious texture, grounded and practical yet dignified for a foundational ruler of Kangla.
appearance.signature: A straight-edged iron-tipped spear about his own height with a leaf-shaped blade, a dark wooden shaft wrapped in deep-red cloth near the grip, and a small bronze serpent motif in low relief just below the spearhead, symbolising his link to Pakhangba and early lallup-style levy warfare.

ref_desc: Nongda Lairen Pakhangba is a lean mid-20s Meitei king with long black hair in a high knot and side-locks, wearing an off-white dhoti, sleeveless upper garment, cream sash and beige shawl with deep-red belt, bronze serpent armband and dark-brown sandals, carrying a straight iron-tipped spear with a red-wrapped grip and bronze serpent motif, in a palette of off-white, deep red, beige, dark brown and pale gold.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Nongda Lairen Pakhangba: a lean, athletic Meitei king in his mid-20s with an oval, high-cheekboned medium-brown face, intense large eyes and calm regal focus; his long straight black hair is parted slightly off-center, pulled into a high knot at the crown with a plain narrow bronze band, a short tail falling to mid-neck and two slim strands left in front of the ears. Show him in era-evocative early Manipur royal clothing: a knee-length off-white handwoven cotton dhoti with a thin deep-red border, a fitted sleeveless off-white cotton upper garment covering the torso, a cream silk sash with subtle pale-gold wave motifs crossing the chest, a broad deep-red waist cloth with a thin dark-green line near the top, and a light beige cotton shawl draped from the left shoulder across the back and under the right arm. Add simple bronze bangles and a single upper-arm bronze band shaped like a subtle coiled serpent, plus dark-brown leather sandals with plain thong straps. His signature weapon is a straight-edged iron-tipped spear about his height, with a leaf-shaped blade, a dark wooden shaft, deep-red cloth wrapping at the grip and a small bronze serpent motif just below the spearhead. Present the character front, side and three-quarter views with consistent off-white, deep red, beige, dark brown and pale-gold colours, clearly showing the high hair knot, garments, serpent armband and spear details in a dignified shonen-anime style.
